people.name: Netophah
people.line: A town in Judah, home to several notable individuals

people.name: Othniel
people.line: First judge of Israel, Caleb's nephew

translations.web: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
translations.bsb: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai the Netophathite, from the family of Othniel. There were 24,000 men in his division.
translations.kjv: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
translations.asv: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
